groups.plain_language: Core power tags used to compare actual export, possible power, schedule and grid constraints.

fields.label: Actual MW
fields.plain_language: Power actually exported by the block or plant.
fields.why_it_matters: This is the line used to evaluate forecast error and schedule deviation.
fields.quality_rule: If unchanged for more than 2 intervals, mark STALE.

fields.label: Possible Power
fields.plain_language: Power the unit could generate if not constrained.
fields.why_it_matters: Separates weather/resource capability from grid curtailment.
fields.quality_rule: Normally should be greater than or equal to actual MW.

fields.label: Scheduled MW
fields.plain_language: Committed generation for the dispatch block.
fields.why_it_matters: Deviation penalty risk is based on actual vs schedule.
fields.quality_rule: Must exist for all active dispatch periods.

groups.plain_language: Tags used to explain whether output is limited by grid or plant controller.

fields.label: Local Limit MW
fields.plain_language: Maximum export allowed at that timestamp.
fields.why_it_matters: If actual is clipped near this line while possible power is higher, classify curtailment.

fields.label: PPC Setpoint
fields.plain_language: Target output set by plant controller.
fields.why_it_matters: Explains whether plant was instructed to reduce output.
fields.quality_rule: Compare with local limit and actual MW.

groups.plain_language: Signals explaining weather/resource availability and ramp risk.

fields.label: POA Irradiance
fields.plain_language: Irradiance falling on the panel plane.
fields.why_it_matters: Primary physical driver of solar generation.

fields.label: Cloud Obstruction Probability
fields.plain_language: Probability that clouds will obstruct solar output soon.
fields.why_it_matters: Early warning signal for cloud ramp-up/down events.
fields.quality_rule: If probability rises before output changes, mark cloud-ramp watch.

fields.label: Module Temperature
fields.why_it_matters: High module temperature reduces PV efficiency.
fields.quality_rule: Check plausibility against ambient temperature and irradiance.

groups.plain_language: Forecast fields used to draw the fan chart and decision bands.

fields.label: P10 Forecast
fields.plain_language: Lower-bound forecast. Output is expected to be above this in most cases.
fields.quality_rule: Must be less than or equal to P50.

fields.label: P50 Forecast
fields.quality_rule: Must lie between P10 and P90.

fields.label: P90 Forecast
fields.quality_rule: Must be greater than or equal to P50.
